statement: The FOMC leaves the federal funds target range unchanged at 3.50 to 3.75 percent at its scheduled meeting of 2026-09-15 to 2026-09-16.
resolution: The FOMC statement published on federalreserve.gov for the September 15-16, 2026 meeting maintains the target range for the federal funds rate at 3.50 to 3.75 percent.
failure_condition: The published September statement sets the target range at any level other than 3.50 to 3.75 percent.

statement: ICE Brent front-month futures settle at or above 100.00 USD per barrel on at least one trading day in the window 2026-08-26 to 2026-10-30.
resolution: The ICE Brent front-month official settlement price is 100.00 USD per barrel or higher on at least one trading day from 2026-08-26 through 2026-10-30 inclusive.
failure_condition: Every ICE Brent front-month daily settlement inside the window prints below 100.00 USD per barrel.

statement: CISA adds at least one Microsoft vulnerability to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a date-added value in the window 2026-08-26 to 2026-11-30.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog contains at least one entry with vendorProject Microsoft and a dateAdded value between 2026-08-26 and 2026-11-30 inclusive.
failure_condition: No KEV entry carries vendorProject Microsoft with a dateAdded value inside the window.

statement: CISA adds at least one PTC vulnerability to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a date-added value in the window 2026-08-26 to 2026-12-31.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog contains at least one entry with vendorProject PTC and a dateAdded value between 2026-08-26 and 2026-12-31 inclusive.
failure_condition: No KEV entry carries vendorProject PTC with a dateAdded value inside the window.

statement: At least one earthquake of magnitude 7.0 or greater occurs worldwide with origin time in the window 2026-08-26 to 2026-10-31 UTC.
resolution: The USGS ComCat catalog lists at least one event of magnitude 7.0 or greater with origin time between 2026-08-26T00:00Z and 2026-10-31T23:59Z.
failure_condition: The USGS catalog holds no event of magnitude 7.0 or greater with origin time inside the window.

statement: Cumulative confirmed Bundibugyo virus cases in the DRC and Uganda outbreak reach 10,000 or more in WHO data covering the period through 2026-10-25.
resolution: A WHO AFRO external situation report covering data through any date up to and including 2026-10-25 records cumulative confirmed cases of 10,000 or more.
failure_condition: The furthest-dated WHO AFRO report covering data through 2026-10-25 records cumulative confirmed cases below 10,000.

statement: The UAE government publicly attributes a missile or drone impact on UAE territory or territorial waters to Iran, for an impact in the window 2026-08-26 to 2026-10-15.
resolution: Reuters and Agence France-Presse both report a UAE government statement attributing a missile or drone impact on UAE territory or territorial waters to Iran within the window.
failure_condition: No UAE government statement in the window attributes a missile or drone impact on its territory or waters to Iran.

statement: Iran publicly agrees to permit unrestricted commercial transit of the Strait of Hormuz under an agreement announced in the window 2026-08-26 to 2026-11-30.
resolution: Reuters and the Associated Press both report an agreement, announced within the window, under which Iran permits unrestricted commercial transit of the Strait of Hormuz.
failure_condition: Transit of the Strait remains conditioned on Iranian permission or restriction at the close of the window.

statement: Croatia surrenders to German custody the Ukrainian diver arrested in Pula on 2026-08-19 over the Nord Stream blasts, in the window 2026-08-26 to 2026-12-11.
resolution: The German Federal Public Prosecutor confirms the suspect has been surrendered by Croatia and brought before a judge of the Federal Court of Justice within the window.
failure_condition: The suspect is not in German custody at the close of the window, whether through Croatian refusal, pending appeal, or release.

statement: NABU or SAPO issues a formal notice of suspicion to a serving or former official of the Ukrainian Office of the President in the window 2026-08-26 to 2026-11-30.
resolution: NABU or SAPO publicly announces a notice of suspicion naming a serving or former Office of the President official, reported by Reuters and Ukrainska Pravda.
failure_condition: No notice of suspicion against a serving or former Office of the President official is announced inside the window.
